about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Mapo Eggplant
recipes.summary: Silky Sichuan-style eggplant in a glossy chilli bean sauce, finished with spring onion and served over rice.

items: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Toss the eggplant with a pinch of salt and let it sit while you prep the rest.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the eggplant for 8 minutes, turning often, until golden and softened. Lift out and set aside.
In the same wok fry the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger for 1 minute until the oil turns red, then add the stock, soy sauce and sugar.
Return the eggplant and simmer for 6 minutes until very tender. Stir in the cornflour slurry and cook for 1 minute until glossy.
Sprinkle with Sichuan pepper and spring onions and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Zha Jiang Mian Beijing Noodles
recipes.summary: Beijing-style wheat noodles topped with a dark, savoury pork and fermented bean sauce and crunchy cucumber.
steps: Fry the pork in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the hoisin sauce, soybean paste, wine, soy sauce and sugar, then add the water.
Simmer on low for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy and the oil rises to the top.
Boil the noodles in plenty of water until just tender, drain well and divide between bowls.
Spoon over the sauce and top with cucumber and spring onions. Toss at the table.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C, and wash hands after handling raw mince.

recipes.title: Hokkien Prawn Mee Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Yellow noodles and thick rice noodles wok-fried with prawns, squid, egg and bean sprouts in a savoury prawn stock.

items: 4 stalks garlic chives, cut in 4cm lengths

steps: Soak the vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Mix the stock, oyster sauce and both soy sauces in a jug.
Heat half the oil in a wok over high heat, fry the garlic for 20 seconds, add the prawns and squid and cook for 2 minutes. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, crack in the eggs and scramble for 30 seconds, then add both noodles and the stock mixture.
Toss for 4 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the noodles are lightly caramelised at the edges.
Return the seafood with the sprouts and chives, toss for 1 minute, and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns, squid and eggs until the prawns are opaque and the noodles are steaming hot, at least 75°C. Contains egg and shellfish.

recipes.title: Mie Goreng Jawa Javanese Fried Noodles
recipes.summary: Smoky Javanese noodles wok-fried with sweet soy sauce, greens, egg and chicken, topped with crisp shallots.
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes, drain and toss with a teaspoon of the oil.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the shallots and garlic for 1 minute. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 minutes until cooked through.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs in the gap, then add the noodles, kecap manis, oyster sauce, soy sauce and pepper.
Add the bok choy and tomato and toss for 3 minutes until the greens wilt and the noodles take on colour.
Serve topped with fried shallots.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Tahu Orek Sticky Sweet Tofu Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu strips tossed in a sticky sweet-chilli kecap manis glaze with green beans, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Lift out onto paper towel.
In the same pan fry the shallots, garlic, chillies and lime leaves for 2 minutes, then add the beans and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the kecap manis, tamarind and sugar with 2 tbsp water and bubble for 1 minute, then return the tofu and toss until coated and sticky.
Serve over the rice while the glaze is still sticky and glossy.

recipes.title: Tahu Telur Surabaya Tofu Omelette
recipes.summary: Fried tofu folded into an egg omelette, served with rice, bean sprouts and a sweet peanut sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime juice, chilli and hot water into a sauce.
Fry the tofu in half the oil for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Beat the eggs with the spring onions, salt and pepper and stir in the tofu.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in the mix, and cook for 4 minutes each side until set and golden.
Cut into wedges, serve over the rice with sprouts and spoon over the peanut sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm all the way through and 75°C. Contains egg and peanuts.

recipes.title: Tahu Bacem Braised Tofu
recipes.summary: Javanese tofu braised in palm sugar, coriander and bay leaf until dark and sticky, then pan-fried.

items: 500g firm tofu, cut into thick slices

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered.
Combine the shallots, garlic, coriander, bay leaves, sugar, kecap manis, tamarind and water in a pan and bring to a simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Add the tofu and simmer for 25 minutes, turning once, until the liquid is nearly gone and the tofu is dark and glazed.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the tofu for 2 minutes each side until the edges caramelise.
Serve with the rice, the remaining glaze spooned over and the cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Pad Kra Pao Moo Thai Holy Basil Pork
recipes.summary: Fiery minced pork wok-fried with garlic, chillies and basil, served over rice with a crisp-edged fried egg.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Crush the garlic and chillies to a rough paste.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and fry the paste for 20 seconds. Add the pork and stir-fry for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked and lightly browned.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar and a splash of water, toss for 1 minute, then fold through the basil until just wilted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil over high heat for 2 minutes until the whites are crisp and the yolks set to your liking.
Serve the pork over rice, each topped with a fried egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains, and cook the eggs until the whites are fully set. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Khao Man Gai Thai Chicken Rice
recipes.summary: Rice cooked in rich chicken broth, topped with poached chicken and a punchy ginger, chilli and soy dipping sauce.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the sliced ginger, salt, 2 garlic cloves and the water, covered, for 25 minutes. Lift out the chicken and keep the broth.
Fry the rice with the remaining crushed garlic for 2 minutes, then cook it in 3 cups of the broth in a covered pot for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Mix the miso, soy sauce, vinegar, grated ginger, chillies, sugar and 2 tbsp broth to make the dipping sauce.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, slice it off the bone and serve on the rice with cucumber and the sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Mi Quang Central Vietnamese Turmeric Noodles
recipes.summary: Wide turmeric rice noodles in a small amount of rich pork and prawn broth, topped with herbs, peanuts and sesame.
steps: Fry the shallots and garlic with the turmeric in the oil for 1 minute. Add the pork and cook for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the tomatoes, stock and fish sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until the pork is tender and the broth reduced by a quarter.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Cook the noodles until tender per the packet, drain and divide between bowls, then ladle over the pork and prawns with a little broth.
Top with sprouts, herbs, peanuts and crackers and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork and prawns until the pork reaches 75°C and the prawns are opaque. Contains shellfish and peanuts.

recipes.title: Com Tam Suon Nuong Broken Rice with Grilled Pork Chop
recipes.summary: Lemongrass-marinated pork chops grilled until charred, served on rice with pickled carrot, cucumber and nuoc cham.
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, 1 tbsp fish sauce, honey, soy sauce and oil, coat the chops and marinate.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Toss the carrot with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and let it pickle.
Whisk the lime juice, remaining fish sauce, sugar, chilli and 3 tbsp water for the dipping sauce.
Grill or pan-fry the chops over medium-high heat for 5 minutes each side until charred and cooked through.
Rest for 3 minutes and serve on rice with the pickled carrot, cucumber, spring onions and dipping sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork chops until the thickest part reaches 75°C with no pink and rest for 3 minutes, and wash hands after handling raw pork.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Bun Bo Xao Lemongrass Beef Noodle Bowl
recipes.summary: Stir-fried lemongrass beef over rice vermicelli with fresh herbs, lettuce, peanuts and a tangy dressing.
steps: Toss the beef with the lemongrass, half the garlic, 1 tbsp fish sauce and half the sugar and leave to sit while you prep.
Cook the vermicelli until tender per the packet, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the remaining fish sauce, sugar and garlic with the lime juice, chilli and water for the dressing.
Stir-fry the beef in the oil in two batches over high heat for 2 minutes each until browned and cooked through.
Build bowls with lettuce, vermicelli, cucumber and herbs, top with beef and peanuts and spoon over the dressing.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C if minced, or 63°C for steak slices, and wash hands after handling raw beef. Contains peanuts.

recipes.title: Pancit Palabok Filipino Prawn Noodles
recipes.summary: Rice noodles under a golden prawn sauce, topped with prawns, egg, crushed chicharron and spring onion.
steps: Cook the noodles until tender per the packet, drain and divide between plates.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes until soft, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the stock and fish sauce.
Simmer for 6 minutes until thick, add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Spoon the sauce and prawns over the noodles and top with egg, crackling and spring onions.
Serve with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until opaque, with the sauce hot to 75°C, and chill leftovers promptly. Contains egg and shellfish.

recipes.title: Katsudon Pork Cutlet Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Crumbed pork cutlets simmered with onion in sweet dashi, set with egg and served over steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm. Flatten the cutlets thin, then coat in flour, egg and panko.
Fry the cutlets in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Drain and slice.
Simmer the onion with the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar for 5 minutes until soft.
Lay the cutlets in the pan, pour the topping eggs over and cover for 1 minute until just set.
Slide over bowls of rice and sprinkle with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 63°C and the eggs are just set; for firm eggs cook until 75°C. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon with Pork and Cabbage
recipes.summary: Chewy udon stir-fried with pork, cabbage and carrot in a savoury Worcestershire-soy sauce, finished with.
steps: Fry the pork in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges.
Add the onion, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender.
Loosen the udon under warm water, add to the pan and toss for 2 minutes until heated through.
Pour in the soy sauce, Worcestershire and mirin and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Serve topped with spring onions and pickled ginger.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw pork.

recipes.title: Omurice Japanese Omelette Rice
recipes.summary: Ketchup-flavoured chicken fried rice wrapped in a soft, silky omelette.
steps: Melt half the butter in a large pan and cook the chicken, onion and carrot for 6 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the rice and peas, break up the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add the ketchup and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt. Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a quarter of the eggs.
Stir the eggs for 20 seconds, then set the base for 30 seconds and spoon a quarter of the rice on one half.
Fold over the omelette, slide onto a plate and repeat to make four.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece and the eggs are set; use cooked rice cooled quickly and eaten within a day. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Jjajangmyeon Black Bean Noodles
recipes.summary: Korean-Chinese noodles in a glossy black bean sauce with pork, zucchini and onion.

items: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water

steps: Fry the black bean paste in the oil for 2 minutes, then remove from the pan. Brown the pork in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the onions, potato and zucchini and cook for 5 minutes. Return the paste, add the sugar, soy sauce and water and simmer for 10 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and cook for 1 minute until thick and glossy.
Boil the noodles until just tender, drain and divide between bowls.
Spoon over the sauce and top with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw pork.

recipes.title: Besan Chilla Chickpea Flour Crepes
recipes.summary: Savoury chickpea flour crepes with ginger, chilli and onion, cooked crisp and served with a coconut chutney.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour with the chillies, ginger, cumin, salt and about 2 cups water into a smooth pouring batter and rest it while you make the chutney.
Blend the coconut, peanuts, extra chilli and water to a coarse chutney with a pinch of salt.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, ladle on batter and spread thin into a 20cm round.
Scatter on onion, drizzle oil around the edges and cook for 3 minutes until crisp underneath, then flip for 1 minute.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve hot with the chutney.
notes: Vegan. Breakfast or lunch.
Plus 10 minutes resting the batter.

recipes.title: Chole Bhature Spiced Chickpeas with Puffed Bread
recipes.summary: Punjabi chickpea curry served with fluffy deep-fried bread.
steps: For the bhature, knead the flour, yoghurt, baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt and water into a soft dough, cover and rest.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, add the ginger and garlic for 1 minute, then the ground spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato puree and cook for 8 minutes until thick and the oil separates, then add the chickpeas, salt and 1 cup water.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick, lightly mashing some of the chickpeas, and stir in the garam masala.
Roll the dough into ovals and deep-fry in hot oil for 1 minute each side until puffed and golden. Serve at once with the chickpeas.
notes: Vegetarian. Dinner. Take care with the hot oil.
Plus 30 minutes resting the dough.

recipes.title: Usal Pav Maharashtrian Bean Curry with Bread
recipes.summary: Spicy black-eyed bean curry from Maharashtra, topped with fried shallots and served with soft bread rolls.
steps: Fry one onion in the oil for 5 minutes until browned, add the coconut, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes and blend with a splash of water to a paste.
Fry the remaining onion for 4 minutes, add the spices and tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until thick.
Stir in the paste, beans, tamarind, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the sprouts are tender and the gravy is thick.
Ladle into bowls and top with the fried shallots, onion and lemon.
Serve with the bread rolls for dipping.
notes: Vegan. Breakfast or lunch.

recipes.title: Kothu Roti Sri Lankan Chopped Roti
recipes.summary: Sri Lankan street food of flatbread chopped on a hot plate with egg, vegetables, chicken and curry spices.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan or wok over high heat, add the curry leaves, onion, garlic and ginger and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and the spices and cook for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then push aside and scramble in the eggs.
Add the shredded flatbreads and salt and chop everything together with two spatulas for 4 minutes until heated and well mixed.
Serve straight from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C, and the eggs until set. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Bangladeshi Khichuri with Egg
recipes.summary: Soft rice and yellow lentils simmered with ginger, turmeric and ghee, served with fried eggs and fried onions.
steps: Rinse the rice and lentils together until the water runs clear.
Heat half the ghee in a heavy pot and fry the bay leaves, cumin, ginger and turmeric for 1 minute, then add the rice and lentils and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the water and salt, bring to the boil then simmer covered for 25 minutes, stirring often, until soft and porridge-like.
Fry the onion in the remaining ghee for 8 minutes until deep golden. Fry the eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Serve the khichuri topped with eggs, fried onion and chillies.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set and the yolks at least 63°C. Contains egg and dairy.

recipes.title: Nihari Slow-Cooked Beef Shank Curry
recipes.summary: Pakistani slow-braised beef shank in a thick, spiced gravy, finished with ginger and green chilli.

items: 1 tbsp fresh ginger, cut in matchsticks

steps: Fry the onions in half the ghee for 12 minutes until deep golden. Remove half for garnish.
Add the remaining ghee, beef, ginger and garlic and brown the beef for 8 minutes, then stir in all the ground spices and salt for 1 minute.
Add the water, bring to the boil then cover and simmer on very low heat for 2 1/2 hours until the beef is falling off the bone.
Whisk the flour with 1/2 cup cold water, stir into the pot and simmer for 10 minutes until the gravy is thick and glossy.
Serve with the fried onions, green chilli, ginger, lemon and naan.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until fork-tender and well above 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Egusi Stew with Spinach and Rice
recipes.summary: Nigerian ground pumpkin seed stew with spinach, tomato, palm oil and chilli, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onion for 4 minutes, then add the blended tomato and capsicum and cook for 12 minutes until the oil rises.
Stir in the pumpkin seeds, chillies, crayfish and stock, add the chicken and simmer covered for 18 minutes until cooked through.
Fold in the spinach and cook for 4 minutes until wilted, season with salt and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Kik Alicha Yellow Split Pea Stew with Flatbread
recipes.summary: Ethiopian-style red lentils slow-cooked with onion, garlic and a warming spice paste, served with flatbread.
steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden. Add the oil, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, chilli powder, paprika, cardamom and cumin and fry for 3 minutes until dark and fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils, water and salt, bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, for 22 minutes until thick and the lentils have broken down.
Serve with warm flatbreads for scooping.

recipes.title: Awaze Tibs Spiced Ethiopian Beef Saute
recipes.summary: Quick-seared beef strips with onion, green chilli and rosemary in a spiced butter, served with flatbread.
steps: Melt half the butter in a large frying pan over high heat and sear the beef in two batches for 2 minutes each. Set aside.
Add the remaining butter, onions, garlic, ginger and chillies and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the paprika, chilli flakes, cardamom, rosemary and salt and stir for 1 minute.
Return the beef with the tomato and toss for 2 minutes until just cooked.
Serve with the flatbreads.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef strips until browned and no pink remains, 63°C for steak cuts, and wash hands after handling raw beef.

recipes.title: Lu Pulu Samoan Taro Leaf Coconut Bake
recipes.summary: Silverbeet and corned beef baked in coconut milk, a Samoan comfort dish served with rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 180C and cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft and stir through the corned beef for 2 minutes.
Place the silverbeet in a baking dish, spoon over the beef mix and season with the salt.
Pour in the coconut milk, cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes, until the greens are soft and the sauce thick.
Serve over rice with lime.
notes: Food safety: reheat the corned beef bake until steaming hot and 75°C throughout, and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.title: Sukiyaki Don Beef Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thigh and soft egg simmered in sweet dashi and served over steamed rice.

items: 500g chicken thigh, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a wide pan, add the onion and chicken and cook for 8 minutes.
Pour the eggs over in a spiral, cover and cook for 1 minute until just set but still soft.
Spoon over bowls of rice and top with spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains egg.

recipes.title: Ayam Goreng Lengkuas Galangal Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Galangal-and-turmeric simmered chicken, shallow-fried until crisp, served with rice, cucumber and a fiery tomato sambal.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the garlic, turmeric, coriander, lime leaves, salt and water, covered, for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Grill the chillies, tomatoes, shallots and shrimp paste until charred, then blend with lime juice and salt into a sambal.
Drain the chicken and pat dry. Shallow-fry in the hot oil for 3 minutes each side until deep golden and crisp.
Serve the chicken with the rice, cucumber and sambal on the side.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part near the bone, and take care with the hot oil. Contains shellfish.

recipes.title: Chapli Kebab Pashtun Spiced Beef Patties
recipes.summary: Pakistani flat patties of spiced beef, tomato and coriander shallow-fried until crisp, served in flatbread.
steps: Mix the mince, onion, tomato, chillies, coriander, ginger, garlic, spices, salt, egg and chickpea flour by hand until sticky.
Shape into 8 flat, wide patties about 1cm thick.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and fry the patties for 5 minutes each side until deep brown and crisp, cooked all the way through.
Drain on paper towel and serve in flatbreads with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef patties until they reach 75°C throughout with no pink, and wash hands after handling raw mince. Contains egg and dairy.
